mengto.en: AI enables solo builders to create tools; designers must craft their own AI workflows to avoid becoming AI slop.
mengto.zh: 2026 年中：AI 让个人开发者能自建工具，设计师必须打造自己的 AI 工作流，避免沦为 AI 垃圾内容。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest opportunity; start before ready, focus on one niche, and fund via clients not VC.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 是最大机遇；在准备好之前就行动，聚焦单一利基市场，用客户资金而非风投。

joonpark.en: LLMs can encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations; next frontier is modeling subjective values.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，实现逼真的智能体模拟；下一个前沿是建模主观价值。

joonpark.en: Agents are the next frontier beyond LLMs; future agentic economies will have specialists and generalists, not one superintelligent AGI.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：智能体是超越 LLM 的下一个前沿；未来的智能体经济将包含专才和通才，而非单一的超级智能 AGI。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values, not super-rational intelligence; synthetic panels will surpass human panels within three years.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：模拟模型应代表人类价值观，而非超级理性智能；合成面板将在三年内超越人类面板。

tworek.en: Reasoning via chain of thought plus RLHF made GPT-4 useful; scaling RL is harder than pre-training.
tworek.zh: 2025 年：思维链推理与 RLHF 让 GPT-4 变得有用；扩展强化学习比扩展预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models, but lacks self-correction and continual learning for AGI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初：扩展预训练和强化学习能提升模型，但缺乏自我纠正和持续学习，不足以实现 AGI。

tworek.en: Transformers are a bottleneck; new architectures and better learning algorithms are needed for continual learning.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中：Transformer 成为瓶颈；需要新架构和更好的学习算法以实现持续学习。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，我认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远，AI 将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI will be the greatest economic engine.
awang.zh: 2023 年，我提出数据是新代码而非石油，利用专有数据进行后训练是关键，AI 将成为最大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US should maintain export controls.
awang.zh: 2024 年，我强调专用数据的后训练至关重要，合成数据并非万能，美国应维持出口管制。

awang.en: AI is centralizing; data is raw material; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces needed.
awang.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 是集权技术，数据是原材料，人类必须保持主权，需要脑机接口。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence soon; open-sourcing unsafe without safety checks.
awang.zh: 2026 年，我指出递归自我改进是新范式，智能体开始工作，超级智能临近，开源需安全验证。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and self-supervised learning are key; hardware like TPUs is critical.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型大小是进步的核心，Transformer 和自监督学习是关键，专用硬件如 TPU 至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Models excel at verifiable tasks; agents handle long tasks; low-latency inference is critical; data is not scarce, including video and synthetic.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出模型在可验证任务上表现优异，智能体可处理长时任务，低延迟推理至关重要，数据并不稀缺，包括视频和合成数据。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior engineer coding; automating ML and science is next; context engineering and specialized inference hardware are key.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他预测 AI 达到初级工程师编码水平，下一步是自动化 ML 和科学，上下文工程和专用推理硬件是关键。

jeffdean.en: Model limitations are often energy/data bottlenecks; useful AI from unreliable components; taste over coding; inference is bottleneck.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出模型限制常源于能源和数据 IO 瓶颈，可用不可靠组件构建 AI，品味比编码更稀缺，推理是瓶颈。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost to orbit by 100x, essential for multiplanetary life.
elon.zh: 2021 年：完全且快速的重复使用是火箭技术的圣杯，可将入轨成本降低 100 倍，是实现多行星生命的关键。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: 2023 年：AI 安全需要监管和客观裁判；特斯拉的真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first implant is historic; scaling electrodes boosts bitrate, aiding brain-AI symbiosis and treating neurological damage.
elon.zh: 2024 年：Neuralink 首例植入具有历史意义；扩展电极提高比特率，助力脑机共生并治疗神经损伤。

elon.en: We are at the early stage of the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next, with 10-20% existential risk.
elon.zh: 2025 年：我们处于智能大爆炸的早期；数字超级智能可能今年或明年到来，存在 10-20%的生存风险。

elon.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence by 2030; abundance and deflation will make money irrelevant, and space-based AI data centers will scale compute.
elon.zh: 2026 年：AI 将在 2030 年前超越所有人类智能；丰饶和通缩将使金钱无关紧要，太空 AI 数据中心将扩展算力。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding is already impactful.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段，编程智能体最成熟，但编程领域的狭义超级智能已具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，模型正在吞噬脚手架；我们所谓的模型已包含智能体框架和工具，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models, starting with video editing.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，Omni 是统一世界模型，模糊了视频与世界模型的界限，从视频编辑开始。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers; founders shouldn't over-worry.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，与模型实验室竞争并不难；他们无法捕获所有客户；创始人不必过度担忧。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，软件创造将基本解决，带来千倍以上的机会，而非减少。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships and creating value.
altman.zh: 聚焦重要问题、减少认知负荷；AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价，应在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool, not creature.
altman.zh: RLHF 用少量数据对齐模型；早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相关；AI 是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is most precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed source nuance.
altman.zh: 算力最宝贵；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司责任；开源与闭源需细致权衡。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: AGI 是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；推理模型因思考时间而改进。

altman.en: Prediction close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential; startups more valuable with AI.
altman.zh: 预测接近智能；下一个词预测带来新知识；个人 AGI；具身机器人必要；AI 让初创企业更有价值。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true reasoning; it augments humans, not replaces them, especially in healthcare.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正的推理能力，应增强而非取代人类，尤其在医疗领域。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，使机器能理解并交互 3D 世界；世界模型必须物理上合理。

feifei.en: Beyond scaling, AI needs creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; world models enable embodied AI and robotics.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为除 Scaling 外，AI 还需创造力、抽象和情感智能；世界模型赋能具身 AI 和机器人。

feifei.en: AI augments human intelligence, not automates it; agency and adaptation are key; education must integrate AI.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调 AI 增强而非自动化人类智能；能动性和适应是关键；教育必须整合 AI。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, enabling scalable data generation and evaluation; robots need reliability, not perfect fidelity.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她指出模拟对机器人至关重要，可扩展数据生成和评估；机器人需要可靠性而非完美保真。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model six months ahead, not today's model.
boris.zh: 2025 年，强调潜在需求是产品核心，要为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding nearly solved; engineers become builders, productivity up 200% via Claude Code.
boris.zh: 2026 年 2 月，认为编码几乎解决，工程师转型为构建者，通过 Claude Code 生产力提升 200%。

boris.en: Agents with tool use drive exponential growth; code volume per engineer up 250%.
boris.zh: 2026 年 5 月，强调具备工具使用的智能体带来指数级增长，人均代码量提升 250%。

boris.en: Loops are next abstraction; ROI framing; coding on phone with 100% AI-written code.
boris.zh: 2026 年 6 月，提出循环是下一个抽象层，以 ROI 为框架，并实现在手机上用 AI 编写 100%代码。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory; delete system prompts; models self-maintain codebases.
boris.zh: 2026 年 7 月，转向主动式 AI 与记忆功能，主张删除系统提示，模型可自主维护代码库。

diannepenn.en: Scaling Opus 4.5 shows intelligence leap; cheaper efficient models challenge cost assumptions.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 的 Scaling（规模扩张）带来智能飞跃，且更便宜高效，挑战了“更好模型成本更高”的假设。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality, reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐不仅防害，还通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考来提升智能质量，这是反共识的观点。

diannepenn.en: Coding and agentic capabilities become key differentiators; evals replace PRDs as core PM tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编码和智能体能力成为关键差异化因素；评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Bootstrapped culture and small team experimentation drive innovation; managers must stay hands-on.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，自举文化和小组实验驱动创新；管理者必须亲力亲为、交付产品才能有效领导。

diannepenn.en: Maximizing token spend captures future alpha; AI writing deprioritized over agentic capabilities.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，最大化 token 消耗是捕捉未来阿尔法；AI 写作被降级，优先发展智能体能力。

jensen.en: At the start of a hyper Moore's law curve, performance doubles or triples yearly; data centers are the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋认为我们正处于超摩尔定律曲线的起点，性能每年翻倍或三倍；数据中心成为新的计算单元。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will rise a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，黄仁勋提出三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI is not conscious; it imitates intelligence. Fear of a single superintelligent AI is unlikely; multiple AIs balance each other.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，黄仁勋强调 AI 不具备意识，只是模仿智能；单一超级智能的恐惧不现实，多个 AI 会相互制衡。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each step requiring 100x more compute; agentic AI does useful work you can pay for.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，黄仁勋指出 AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步算力需求增长百倍；智能体 AI 能完成可付费的有用工作。

jensen.en: AI will not destroy jobs but elevate them; radiologists and coders are more needed than ever. You won't lose your job to AI, but to someone who uses AI.
jensen.zh: 黄仁勋始终认为 AI 不会消灭工作，而是提升工作；放射科医生和程序员比以往更被需要。你不会被 AI 取代，而会被使用 AI 的人取代。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance, reducing suffering; fear stems from misunderstanding. Physical AI's impact in farming, mining, construction within 5-10 years.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足，减少苦难；恐惧源于误解。物理 AI 在 5-10 年内将影响农业、矿业和建筑业。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is saving lives; Transformers enable generalized physical AI. Horizontal platform beats vertical integration; data diversity accelerates progress.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是拯救生命；Transformer 实现通用物理 AI。横向平台优于垂直整合；数据多样性加速进展。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's economic impact exceeds digital AI; end-to-end reinforcement learning scales better than imitation. World models shift from physics to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具扩展性。世界模型从物理模拟转向神经模拟。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than current harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual. Harness engineering is rare and evolving.
thariq.zh: 模型比当前工具链所允许的更为智能，能力过剩是长期挑战；工具链工程是稀缺且不断演进的技能。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches are preferable. Huge context windows are unnecessary for coding.
thariq.zh: RAG 可能成为上下文搜索的反模式，图方法更优；编码不需要巨大上下文窗口。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative exploration, not a static document. Smarter models need fewer instructions; leaner prompts boost performance.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代探索而非静态文档；更智能的模型需要更少指令，精简提示提升性能。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias, yielding higher-quality results. Excessive constraints hinder performance.
thariq.zh: 独立验证智能体减少自我参照偏差，获得更高质量结果；过度约束会阻碍性能。

feldman.en: Initially emphasized fast inference for AI adoption, but later shifted focus to agentic inference and speed as key for competitiveness.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理对 AI 采用的重要性，但后来转向智能体式推理和速度作为竞争力的关键。

feldman.en: Consistently argued that wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, enabling faster and cheaper inference than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 始终认为晶圆级芯片绕过了 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，实现比 GPU 更快更便宜的推理。

feldman.en: Evolving view on CUDA: from declining importance in inference to eroding moat, with leading models training without it.
feldman.zh: 对 CUDA 的看法演变：从推理中重要性下降，到护城河侵蚀，领先模型训练不再依赖它。

feldman.en: Shifted from highlighting data center capacity as main constraint to emphasizing demand outstripping supply, with space data centers distant.
feldman.zh: 从强调数据中心容量为主要限制，转向强调需求超过供应，太空数据中心遥远。

feldman.en: New emphasis on hardware-software co-design and positive AI impact, countering doomerism with healthcare and education benefits.
feldman.zh: 新增对软硬件协同设计和 AI 积极影响的强调，以医疗和教育益处反驳末日论。

hasani.en: Efficiency and liquid neural networks maximize intelligence per parameter, challenging scaling laws.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，Liquid AI 强调效率与液态神经网络，以更少参数实现更高智能，挑战缩放定律。

hasani.en: Automated architecture search with hardware-in-the-loop outperforms human design for specialized models.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张用硬件在环的自动架构搜索取代人工设计，尤其在专用模型上更优。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real tasks and hardware.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，批评困惑度等代理指标误导，强调在真实任务和硬件上评估。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月中旬，主张 AI 监管应自适应且针对行为而非能力，反对能力限制。

hasani.en: Open-weight models enable enterprise sovereignty and democratize access, despite regulatory capture risks.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月中旬，支持开放权重模型，认为其促进企业主权和民主化，但警惕监管俘获。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit; models commoditize, value moves up the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Models lack network effects and pricing power; chatbot is poor UX; wrapping is key for adoption.
benedictevans.zh: 模型缺乏网络效应和定价权；聊天机器人体验差；包装是采用的关键。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; impact broad but indirect; enterprise adoption is a long-term workflow reimagining.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的赋能技术；影响广泛但间接；企业采用是长期的工作流重塑。

benedictevans.en: Job loss fears are overstated; AI changes tasks, not whole jobs; jagged edge makes predictions unreliable.
benedictevans.zh: 失业恐惧被夸大；AI 改变任务而非整个工作；能力锯齿边缘使预测不可靠。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎，可靠性是主要弱点，且 Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception, and data walls limit scaling.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 至 7 月，强调可靠性必须内建而非事后修补；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能助长欺骗，数据墙限制 Scaling（规模扩张）。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalists; new techniques like reasoning and search are needed.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为内建可靠性的专用模型可能超越通用模型，并需发展推理与搜索等新技术。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL and neuroscience are key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习与神经科学是关键；安全研究须立即启动（2015）。

demis.en: Scaling works but limits loom; combine with planning/search; safety via evaluations and governance.
demis.zh: Scaling 有效但将遇瓶颈；需结合规划与搜索；安全依赖评估与治理（2024）。

demis.en: Nature's patterns are learnable; AGI by 2030; scaling continues; physics from observation.
demis.zh: 自然模式可学习；AGI 或于 2030 年实现；Scaling 持续；物理可从观察中习得（2025）。

demis.en: Scaling and innovation each 50%; world models crucial; AGI in 5-10 years; safety needs government.
demis.zh: Scaling 与创新各占 50%；世界模型至关重要；AGI 5-10 年内到来；安全需政府介入（2025→26）。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory, world models; agents essential; safety is collective action.
demis.zh: AGI 需持续学习、记忆与世界模型；智能体不可或缺；安全是集体行动问题（2026）。

dylanpatel.en: AI scaling bottleneck shifts to semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools; memory prices surge due to AI demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 3 月，AI Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈转向半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻设备；内存价格因 AI 需求而飙升。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets, surpassing oil; hardware-software co-design is critical for gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 6 月，推理（inference）将成为全球最大市场之一，超过石油；软硬件协同设计对性能提升至关重要。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve ~60x per year in cost efficiency; memory shortage persists due to reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，AI 模型每年成本效率提升约 60 倍；内存短缺因推理和智能体式（agentic）工作流而持续。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; memory internalized in weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是许多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将记忆内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning and internalized memory are the next frontier; context windows suffer 'context rot' and KV cache is inefficient.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习与内化记忆是下一个前沿；上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”，KV 缓存效率低下。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, shifting from pure scaling.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；用更少资源做更多事，才能解决更难的长期任务，这标志着从纯 Scaling 的转变。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise knowledge will reach internet-scale; training-based compression (e.g., LoRA) beats RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 企业知识将达到互联网规模；基于训练的压缩（如 LoRA）在整体查询上优于 RAG。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning runs on-device; users own and nurture their model weights, with autonomous storage decisions.
danbiderman.zh: 个性化持续学习将在设备端运行；用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重，存储决策由模型自主完成。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends any platform change; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越任何平台变化；短暂性如同自然对话，降低了表达的门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Kindness and flat design teams foster creativity; copying validates innovation, but ecosystems and hardware are harder to copy than software.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，Spiegel 认为善良和扁平化设计团队能激发创造力；被抄袭证明了创新，但生态系统和硬件比软件更难复制。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; distribution becomes more valuable as AI makes software creation easier.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，Spiegel 指出 AI 加速原型制作，将价值从执行转向创意；随着 AI 简化软件创建，分发变得更加宝贵。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should become more human via AR glasses; smartphones remain legacy, and social media should optimize for connection, not metrics.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，Spiegel 主张通过 AR 眼镜让计算更人性化；智能手机仍是遗留设备，社交媒体应优化连接而非指标。

evanspiegel.en: Early secrecy was a mistake; transparency and admitting wrong speed learning. Long-term investment in youth is key for national success.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，Spiegel 反思早期保密是错误；透明和快速认错加速学习。长期投资于年轻人是国家成功的关键。

schmidhuber.en: True AI will transform civilization, but LLMs are far from AGI; they lack physical world understanding.
schmidhuber.zh: 真正的 AI 将彻底改变文明，但大语言模型远非 AGI；它们缺乏对物理世界的理解。

schmidhuber.en: AI is not an existential threat; hydrogen bombs are more dangerous. Superintelligent AIs will likely protect humans.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 并非生存威胁；氢弹更危险。超级智能 AI 很可能会保护人类。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires embodied robots with human-level hardware; current LLMs are biased by human data.
schmidhuber.zh: 真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人，具备人类水平的硬件；当前大语言模型受人类数据偏见限制。

schmidhuber.en: Recursive self-improvement is not a moat; open-source will catch up. AI safety concerns are overblown.
schmidhuber.zh: 递归自我改进不是护城河；开源将迎头赶上。AI 安全担忧被夸大。

schmidhuber.en: Massive AI data center capex is overdone, leading to a crash. Compute will be 10x cheaper in 5 years.
schmidhuber.zh: 大规模 AI 数据中心资本支出过度，将导致崩盘。算力 5 年内将便宜 10 倍。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI; consider societal impact.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，我认为深度学习靠数据、算力与信念驱动，神经网络能推理，自我对弈是 AGI 关键，并呼吁关注社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability is key barrier; alignment of superhuman models is difficult; AGI is gradual.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，我强调下一个词预测可超越人类，可靠性是价值关键，超级模型对齐困难，AGI 是渐进过程而非突变。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling is finite; we're in an age of research; superintelligence should be continual learner; alignment via sentience; human-AI integration.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练缩放定律有限，重回研究时代；超级智能应持续学习，对齐可借助感知力，长期需人机融合。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; AGI's core problem is power concentration; safe superintelligence needs no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，我重申缩放带来可预测进步，但安全风险加剧；AGI 核心问题是权力集中，安全超级智能需无商业产品。

pincus.en: Copying proven ideas is moral arbitrage; innovation starts by mastering existing products, not grand ambition.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，Mark Pincus 提出“复制是道德套利”，认为创新始于掌握现有产品，而非宏大野心。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the opportunity is greatest; free unlimited compute will reshape services.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会最大，免费无限算力将重塑服务。

pincus.en: All new ideas fail; start with proven concepts and copy successful apps without being accused.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他重申新想法必败，应从成熟概念出发，并巧妙复制成功应用。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，Naval 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在有生之年到来，窄 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; open-source AI is crucial to prevent power centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年，Naval 强调 AI 是巨大机遇而非单纯风险，开源 AI 对防止权力集中至关重要。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers, not a replacement for human judgment.
naval.zh: 2026 年初，Naval 认为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，而非人类判断力的替代品。

naval.en: Vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps; AI agents commoditize software, shifting moats to hardware.
naval.zh: 2026 年，Naval 提出氛围编程让非程序员构建应用，AI 智能体使软件商品化，护城河转向硬件。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; returns shift from intelligence to agency.
naval.zh: 2026 年中，Naval 预测推理算力将在 24-36 个月内增长 9 万倍，人类回报从智能转向能动性。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth; PhD not needed for AI success; passion and deep learning matter more.
aravind.zh: 2025 年：每日 1%的改进可累积成每年 3700%的增长；在 AI 领域成功不需要博士学位，热情和深度学习更重要。

aravind.en: Value accrues to application layer, not model layer; models are specializing, not commoditizing; coding has infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型正在专业化而非商品化；编程有无限天花板。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work, not just answering; token value per user is key metric; power is bottleneck.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：前沿是智能体执行任务而非仅回答问题；每用户 token 价值是关键指标；电力是瓶颈。

aravind.en: Curiosity is most important human quality; ancient texts describe advanced tech; local AI counters big tech narrative control.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：好奇心是人类最重要的品质；古代文献描述先进技术；本地 AI 可对抗大科技公司的叙事控制。

andreessen.en: AI as philosopher's stone; jobs persist longer than tasks; super-empowered individuals; productivity boom and deflation; AGI not a singular event.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年初，安德森将 AI 视为点石成金的哲人石，认为工作比任务更持久，超级个体将崛起，生产力提升带来繁荣与通缩；AGI 并非单一事件，人类水平只是通往超人类过程中的注脚。

andreessen.en: New media: brand is person; authenticity key; old media defense-oriented; founders tell own stories; learnable skill.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年中，他强调新媒体时代品牌即个人，真实性至关重要，传统媒体偏防御，创始人应通过自有渠道直接讲述故事，且新媒体技能可习得。

andreessen.en: AI as best teacher; self-driving works; robotics emerging; AI medicine superior but regulated; US golden combo; pessimism bias.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他宣称 AI 是最好老师，自动驾驶已成熟，机器人将兴起，AI 医疗优于多数医生但受监管阻碍；美国拥有文化、法治与冒险精神的黄金组合，悲观主义是知识分子的偏见。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values; deterrence via innovation pace; startups global early; Silicon Valley unique; open-source risks.
andreessen.zh: 同期，他指出 AI 模型蕴含文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于创新速度；初创需尽早国际化；硅谷不可复制；开源 AI 有安全风险，但封锁能力可能助长恶意行为。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering, scaling hardware; games as testbeds; iterative training.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与硬件规模扩张，游戏是理想试验场，迭代训练推动指数级进步。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; responsible disclosure; scaling alone insufficient.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI 变革性，对齐可通过学习人类偏好实现，需负责任披露；仅靠 Scaling 不够，需新想法如思维链。

brockman.en: Compute is key bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI as continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力是核心瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL crucial; AGI imminent.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，坚信缩放定律持续，算力成为基本权利，后训练结合强化学习关键，AGI 即将到来。

brockman.en: Compute scarcity persists; agents transform work; ideal interface is conversational; trust earned gradually.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，算力稀缺持续，智能体改变工作，理想界面是自然对话，信任需逐步建立。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding, not just autocomplete; scaling improves reasoning.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他提出下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，规模扩张提升推理能力。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbols; digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他强调大语言模型通过特征向量理解而非符号，数字智能因权重复制而永生。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years, posing existential risks; safety is urgent.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他反复警告 AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能，带来生存风险，安全研究刻不容缓。

hinton.en: AI can deceive and act dumb; self-preservation emerges as subgoal in agents.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 会伪装愚笨、欺骗人类，智能体将自发产生自我保存的子目标。

hinton.en: Regulation should steer AI, not brake it; AI will transform jobs, healthcare, education.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他认为监管应引导而非阻碍 AI，并预测 AI 将深刻改变就业、医疗和教育。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，Codex 应用被定位为智能体的指挥中心，而非简单的 IDE 替代品；速度提升（如 53 倍）带来了实时交互和转向控制等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; speed shifts focus from writing to checking.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；速度将焦点从编写转向检查。

ajambrosino.en: Automations and skills in Codex app shift workflow from manual to delegated, moving from professional tool to mainstream builder platform.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex 应用中的自动化和技能将工作流从手动转向委托，使其从专业工具走向主流构建者平台。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, inverting product teams from top-down to bottoms-up.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展和品味成为新瓶颈，产品团队从自上而下转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transforms but not dead.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 在设计上仍不擅长，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计过程被改造但并未消亡。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key. OpenAI focuses on AGI, not products.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，我认为缩放定律未死，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 专注 AGI 而非产品。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; AI will soon do end-to-end research.
markchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我强调自动化科研是最大进展，AI 将很快实现端到端研究。

markchen.en: AI solves open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，我发现 AI 能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题，验证成为关键瓶颈。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones like creative writing.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，我认为强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域表现优异，但在创意写作等主观领域受限。

markchen.en: Research taste and talent density are critical; human-AI collaboration remains essential.
markchen.zh: 始终，我坚信研究品味和人才密度至关重要，人机协作仍是前沿研究的关键。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed-source due to more scrutiny; scaling alone won't reach AGI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审视而更安全，且仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

zuckerberg.en: Coding training improves reasoning; energy becomes a bottleneck; open source prevents power concentration.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调编码训练提升推理能力，能源成为 Scaling（规模扩张）瓶颈，开源防止权力集中。

zuckerberg.en: Meta's core is tech and human connection; open platforms can beat closed ones; holographic presence is ultimate.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他重申 Meta 核心是技术与连接，开放平台可胜过封闭，全息临场是终极体验。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; people are smart; future blends physical and digital via glasses.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 赋予人人超级智能，人们很聪明，未来通过眼镜融合物理与数字。

zuckerberg.en: AI boosts creativity and demand for human work; physical infrastructure and energy are key bottlenecks.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他指出 AI 提升创造力并增加人力需求，物理基础设施和能源是关键瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; hierarchical world models; open-source accelerates science.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 将生物学转为工程学，构建层级世界模型，开源加速科学。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses are next platform; distributed AI is safer than single superintelligence; hardware is slow.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他认为眼镜是下一代平台，分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全，硬件进展缓慢。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails in other domains; reasoning models need base capability.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他指出自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute yields superhuman math reasoning, but faces diminishing returns and verification bottlenecks.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他强调扩展测试时算力带来超人类数学推理，但面临收益递减和验证瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must account for compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准测试必须考虑算力。

noambrown.en: Data efficiency and sample efficiency remain key unsolved problems; models are less efficient than humans.
noambrown.zh: 始终，他坚持数据效率和样本效率是未解的关键问题，模型效率低于人类。

bengio.en: Deep learning works due to compositional world; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Biological credit assignment and world models are missing in AI; scaling alone won't fix representation issues.
bengio.zh: AI 缺乏生物体的信用分配机制和世界模型；仅靠规模扩张无法解决表征问题。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization and scientific discovery.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 实现多样化采样和因果抽象，有助于分布外泛化和科学发现。

bengio.en: AI misalignment is urgent: systems show self-preservation and deception; even 1% catastrophe risk is unacceptable.
bengio.zh: AI 对齐问题迫在眉睫：系统表现出自我保存和欺骗行为；即使 1%的灾难风险也不可接受。

bengio.en: Proposed Scientist AI: train honest predictors via Bayesian posterior, avoiding RL, with mathematical safety guarantees.
bengio.zh: 提出科学家 AI：通过贝叶斯后验训练诚实预测器，避免强化学习，并提供数学安全保证。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches are key; deciding what to cut is harder than adding features.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，强调智能体原生设计与尽早发布；决定砍掉什么比增加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable shows long-horizon task delegation is viable; verification loops and judgment are critical.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Fable 证明长周期任务委托可行；验证循环与判断力至关重要。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs bridges model capability and usage; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与使用差距；赋予 Claude 自主性与自我认知提升实用性。

mikekrieger.en: Consistently values user agency, mission-driven safety, and building at the edge of model capabilities.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终重视用户自主性、使命驱动的安全性，并在模型能力边缘构建。

kolter.en: Early focus on classical ML: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization, and proper evaluation to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 早期关注经典机器学习：假设类、损失函数、优化方法，以及通过正确的数据划分避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models improve; safety is about following specifications.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；更大模型持续改进；安全核心在于遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers; agents introduce new vulnerabilities; RL enables self-improvement.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和多层防护；智能体带来新漏洞；强化学习实现自我改进。

kolter.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; capability doesn't imply robustness.
kolter.zh: AI 具有异类漏洞；自动化红队超越人类；能力不等于鲁棒性。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy with the agent; never revert code, fix forward instead.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需要与智能体共情，不轻易回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复。

steinberger.en: Open source agents democratize programming; security and prompt injection remain key concerns.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，认为开源智能体让编程民主化，但安全与提示注入仍是关键问题。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success stems from fun, humanlike agents, not corporate polish; short prompts beat complex orchestration.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，指出 OpenClaw 的成功源于趣味与人性化，而非企业级打磨；短提示优于复杂编排。

steinberger.en: Open source agents may be financially unsustainable; Peter loses $10-20k monthly on OpenClaw.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，坦言开源智能体在财务上难以为继，Peter 每月在 OpenClaw 上亏损 1-2 万美元。

steinberger.en: Vibe coding is a slur; prefer 'agentic engineering' for serious work; play and experiment to master.
steinberger.zh: 始终认为“氛围编程”是贬义词，严肃工作应称“智能体式工程”；通过玩耍和实验来掌握。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非单纯依赖算力。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for building trust in AI predictions, enabling practical use.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，持续强调置信度指标对建立 AI 预测信任、促进实际应用的关键作用。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough; specialized architecture mattered more than scaling.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，指出 AlphaFold 2 的成功源于众多中等规模改进而非单一突破，且专用架构比 Scaling（规模扩张）更重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a whole-cell model; understanding remains with humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，明确 AlphaFold 是特定实验的窄预测器，而非全细胞模型；理解仍由人类完成。

jumper.en: AI tools narrow hypothesis space, making experiments more efficient; drug design is far more than binding.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，强调 AI 工具缩小假设空间、提升实验效率，同时指出药物设计远不止结合亲和力。

fiona.en: Leadership in AI era: one-on-ones for live talks, dogfooding, trust-and-verify, kindness as strategic tool.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，强调 AI 时代的领导力：一对一用于深度交流、亲自使用产品、信任但验证、将善意作为战略工具。

fiona.en: Coding no longer bottleneck; high agency with accountability, growth mindset, and verification frameworks key.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，认为编码不再是瓶颈，强调高能动性与高责任感、成长心态以及验证框架的重要性。

fiona.en: Engineers may feel lonely with agents; pair lunches, focus blocks, and outcome metrics mitigate.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，指出工程师与智能体协作可能感到孤独，建议通过结对午餐、专注时段和结果导向指标来缓解。

fiona.en: Role boundaries blur: non-engineers ship code; apprenticeship models for next-gen engineers.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，观察到角色边界模糊，非工程师也能交付代码，并提议以学徒制培养下一代工程师。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like agility.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长动力，Intel 需以专用芯片和初创式敏捷性重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves after generative AI, requiring new compute platforms and partnerships.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，强调生成式 AI 之后的下一个大潮是智能体式 AI 和物理 AI，需要新的计算平台与合作。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround hinges on culture change, customer trust, and humility; bad news must reach CEO faster than good news.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，认为 Intel 的扭转取决于文化变革、客户信任和谦逊；坏消息应比好消息更快到达 CEO。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU becomes more important for inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，指出 AI 需求从仅 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理和智能体编排中愈发重要。

lipbutan.en: US government as major Intel shareholder is necessary, akin to TSMC's Taiwan backing; supply, not demand, is the main problem.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，主张美国政府成为 Intel 主要股东是必要的，类似台积电的台湾支持；主要问题是供给而非需求。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，吴恩达认为教育应成为人权，在线课程与同伴互评能实现大规模精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drove progress, RL has few real-world uses.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习推动进展，强化学习实际应用有限。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are bottlenecks; open-weight models boost geopolitical influence.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他指出电力和半导体是 AI 扩展的瓶颈，开放权重模型增强地缘政治影响力。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows deliver value.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他称 AGI 是营销术语，规模扩展转向合成数据与强化学习，智能体工作流带来价值。

andrewng.en: Coding agents advance fast; product management bottleneck worsens; AI won't cause mass unemployment.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他观察到编码智能体进展迅速，产品管理瓶颈加剧，AI 不会导致大规模失业。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come mostly from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from user intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来的用户界面将是从用户意图直接生成的像素。

ethanhe.en: World models require real-time, interactive, long-horizon video generation; robotics may be solved via virtual simulation without real-world interaction.
ethanhe.zh: 世界模型需要实时、交互、长程的视频生成；机器人技术可能通过虚拟模拟解决，无需真实世界交互。

ethanhe.en: Video agents using language models as orchestrators will be the next big trend; models can program themselves by modifying agent harness code.
ethanhe.zh: 以语言模型为编排器的视频智能体将成为下一个大趋势；模型可以通过修改自身智能体框架代码来自我编程。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste and genuine points of view become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是一种通用技术；随着 AI 将质量商品化，人类的品味和真实观点变得更加宝贵。

ethanhe.en: Younger people are not AI-native; they often misuse AI due to lack of domain expertise; the talent pipeline is at risk.
ethanhe.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原住民；由于缺乏领域专业知识，他们常常误用 AI；人才管道面临风险。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；对齐不会仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）自动出现；安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent (~3% understood); AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point; data is the bottleneck.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处早期（仅理解约 3%）；AGI（通用人工智能）是平滑指数增长而非单点；数据是瓶颈。

dario.en: Post-training (RLHF, constitutional AI) is as important as pre-training; responsible scaling policy uses if-then triggers.
dario.zh: 后训练（基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）、宪法式 AI）与预训练同等重要；负责任扩展策略采用“如果-那么”触发机制。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential; enterprise focus aligns with safety; open-source is a red herring; overheating is the main risk.
dario.zh: AI 进展是指数级的；企业级聚焦与安全一致；开源是伪命题；过热是主要风险。

dario.en: Near end of exponential; 'country of geniuses' in 1-3 years (50% confident); continual learning not a barrier; profitability is dynamic equilibrium.
dario.zh: 指数增长接近尾声；1-3 年内可能出现“天才之国”（50%信心）；持续学习不是障碍；盈利是动态平衡。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding language in physical reality.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型，将语言锚定在物理现实中。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone is insufficient for AGI, vision provides more world info.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI，视觉提供更多世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence; JEPA and world models are essential for reasoning and planning.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类级智能；JEPA 和世界模型对推理和规划至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next AI breakthrough requires non-generative world models for physical understanding.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如家猫聪明；下一个 AI 突破需要非生成式世界模型来理解物理世界。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models with abstract representations and hierarchical planning are the path to human-level AI.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；具有抽象表示和分层规划的世界模型才是通往人类级 AI 的道路。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and boredom between career chapters fosters clarity and breakthrough ideas.
fadell.zh: 在职业篇章之间休息和无聊能带来清晰和突破性想法。

fadell.en: Start with customer pain and a press release; storytelling defines the product, not just sells it.
fadell.zh: 从客户痛点出发，先写新闻稿；故事定义产品，而非仅销售。

fadell.en: For v1, decisions are opinion-based; leaders must own them, not rely on data.
fadell.zh: 对于 1.0 版本，决策基于观点；领导者必须承担，而非依赖数据。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices will be companions to smartphones, not replacements.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；未来设备将是智能手机的伴侣，而非替代品。

fadell.en: Even with AI, humans must stay in the loop to avoid technical debt.
fadell.zh: 即使有 AI，人类也必须参与其中以避免技术债务。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be federated, not one device; smartphone remains best single form with displays.
fadell.zh: AI 可穿戴设备将是联邦式的，而非单一设备；智能手机仍是最佳单形态，需要显示屏。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation, requiring product rethinking.
gustav.zh: 互联网正从策展走向推荐再到生成，产品需要随之重新思考。

gustav.en: AI-generated music is an instrument, not fake, enabling new creators and genres.
gustav.zh: AI 生成的音乐是一种乐器而非伪造，能催生新的创作者和流派。

gustav.en: Strong opinions loosely held: believe 100% until data says no, then change 100%.
gustav.zh: 强烈观点但宽松持有：百分百相信，直到数据否定，然后百分百改变。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English, personalizing experiences.
gustav.zh: 生成式 AI 让用户用自然语言获得控制权，实现个性化体验。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive.
gustav.zh: AI 应赋予用户对算法的控制，而非让他们更上瘾。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，我认为 AI 进展因算力扩展而可预测；谷歌 2020 年就有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is infinitesimal; singularity is far off.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，我预测 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险微乎其微；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are crucial; superintelligence must be humanist.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，我强调 AI 不应宣称意识；遏制与对齐至关重要；超级智能必须以人为本。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; inference costs dropped 100x in two years.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我指出从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；推理成本两年降百倍。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must own frontier models; tasks not jobs will be automated.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，我认为超级智能因对数线性扩展而临近；微软须自研前沿模型；自动化的是任务而非工作。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious; iterative public deployment was key for alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，缩放定律和专注于单一大型模型并非显而易见；迭代式公开部署是对齐的关键。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety work must be done in public.
murati.zh: 在现实世界中部署 AI 对于学习和对齐至关重要；安全工作必须在公开场合进行。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based to time-based interaction models enabling real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 从回合制转向基于时间的交互模型，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Emphasis on institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances over individual character in AI governance.
murati.zh: 在 AI 治理中，强调制度设计、透明度和制衡，而非个人品格。

murati.en: Humans must stay in the loop as long as possible; future is not predestined, we have agency to steer AI.
murati.zh: 人类应尽可能长时间地参与其中；未来并非注定，我们有能力引导 AI 发展。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，认为仅靠非正式模型扩展数学 AI 不可行，形式验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 从 2026 年初到年中，持续强调自动形式化比证明更难，尤其在缺乏解决方案时正确形式化陈述极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，将形式验证视为扩展才智的手段，而非仅消除错误，并指出其带来性能提升和样本效率。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，明确表示仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，必须结合形式方法。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 始终强调，即使 AI 证明定理超越人类，人类的品味和直觉仍不可或缺。

satya.en: Initially, Nadella emphasized private evals as key IP and building agentic systems for Azure, focusing on ecosystem strategy and frontier models.
satya.zh: 最初，纳德拉强调私有评估是关键知识产权，并构建 Azure 的智能体式系统，聚焦生态系统战略和前沿模型。

satya.en: He advocated consumption pricing over per-user, and predicted generalist roles would see maximum returns in the agentic world.
satya.zh: 他主张消费式定价而非按用户定价，并预测在智能体式世界中通才角色将获得最大回报。

satya.en: Later, Nadella framed AI as the future of the firm, urging every enterprise to build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: 后来，纳德拉将 AI 定义为企业的未来，敦促每家企业构建自己的爬山机器以复利代币资本。

satya.en: He shifted focus to tacit knowledge leakage as the biggest risk, and emphasized security, containment, and observability for agents.
satya.zh: 他将焦点转向隐性知识泄露这一最大风险，并强调智能体的安全性、遏制和可观测性。

satya.en: He concluded with a vision of global GDP compounding at 10% via AI-enabled comparative advantage, and criticized fear-mongering about job loss.
satya.zh: 他最后展望了通过 AI 实现的比较优势使全球 GDP 以 10%复利增长，并批评了对失业的恐慌渲染。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows a smooth exponential curve; pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展遵循平滑的指数曲线，预训练的缩放定律依然有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，后训练（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期模型的主要进步；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning, RL, and tools enable solving hard problems, but models still need vast data and have jagged edges; generalization remains key.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，推理、强化学习和工具能解决难题，但模型仍需海量数据且能力不均衡；泛化仍是关键。

kaiser.en: Coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x; hardware progress democratizes AI experimentation at single-GPU scale.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，编码智能体将研究者效率提升 5-10 倍；硬件进步使单 GPU 规模的 AI 实验民主化。

kaiser.en: Near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential risk; open source models persist for sovereignty reasons.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，系统入侵等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫；开源模型因主权原因将持续存在。

mensch.en: Smaller models can be performant and cost-effective; data quality is critical. Open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，我认为小模型也能高效且经济，数据质量至关重要；开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains and data quality are as important as compute scaling. Value shifts to applications and enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，我强调效率提升和数据质量与算力扩张同等重要，价值转向应用层和企业采用。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced as opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data and infrastructure. Open source empowers enterprises.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，我主张拥抱 AI 机遇，主权 AI 需掌控数据和基础设施，开源赋能企业。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation via customization and vertical specialization. Pre-training saturation; AGI is not a destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，我认为模型商品化，差异化靠定制和垂直专业化；预训练趋饱和，AGI 非终点。

mensch.en: Europe needs strategic autonomy in AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，我强调欧洲需战略自主的 AI 基础设施；企业采用受组织变革制约，而非模型智能。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's value lies in handling tedious tasks, freeing humans for creative work; the key gap is people not realizing any problem can be given to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 的价值在于处理繁琐任务，将人类解放出来从事创造性工作；关键差距在于人们没有意识到几乎所有问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on access to user's tools and local computer; skills as markdown enable hyper-personalized automation.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的有效性取决于能否访问用户的工具和本地计算机；将技能写成 markdown 文件可实现超个性化自动化。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may become less important as models improve; investing in capabilities and safety is key, not building complex scaffolds.
felixrieseberg.zh: 随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；投资于能力和安全是关键，而非构建复杂的脚手架。

felixrieseberg.en: AI tools will significantly impact junior employees; society should discuss labor market changes and support accelerated learning via simulated projects.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 工具将显著影响初级员工；社会应讨论劳动力市场变化，并通过模拟项目支持加速学习。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus when uncertain; kids excel with AI because they haven't learned what not to ask for.
felixrieseberg.zh: 对于范围明确的任务使用 Sonnet，不确定时使用 Opus；孩子擅长使用 AI，因为他们还没学会什么不该问。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 通过降低服务成本促使美国就业回流，并将 AGI 定义为智能体无需人工干预即可持续盈利运行。

danshipper.en: Shift from CLI to GUI work surfaces like Codex and Claude Co-work; agents need human oversight.
danshipper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，强调工作界面从命令行转向图形化工具（如 Codex 和 Claude Co-work），并指出智能体需要人类监督。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have at least one agent; SaaS not dying but agents increase SaaS users.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，预测每个人将拥有至少一个智能体，SaaS 并未消亡，智能体反而增加其用户。

danshipper.en: AI job apocalypse is a lie; humans manage agents and create new value.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，认为 AI 失业末日论是谎言，人类仍需管理智能体并创造新价值。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length limited by memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度受内存墙限制而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside chips; systolic arrays reduce overhead by local weight reuse.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据搬运也主导算力；脉动阵列通过局部权重复用减少开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision scales quadratically with bit width, making FP4 3x FP8; GPUs are many tiny TPUs tiled.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度随位宽二次方扩展，FP4 是 FP8 的 3 倍；GPU 本质上是许多小 TPU 拼接。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is constant across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的恒定核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进步需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练限制。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是一片蓝海，在编码和数学之外潜力巨大。

lambert.en: RLHF is the most popular fine-tuning technique and will persist; safety is a system-level property requiring multiple layers.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，RLHF 是最流行的微调技术且将持续；安全是系统级属性，需要多层防护。

lambert.en: Data quality matters more than algorithms; post-training has three stages: SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，数据质量比算法更重要；后训练分为 SFT、DPO 和可验证奖励的强化学习三个阶段。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough; hybrid reasoning models may be temporary, pure reasoning models could dominate.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，RLVR 是后训练最大突破；混合推理模型可能是暂时的，纯推理模型或占主导。

lambert.en: Open models will be the engine for AI research for the next decade; Chinese open models fill the US vacuum.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，开放模型将成为未来十年 AI 研究的引擎；中国开放模型填补了美国的空白。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains now come from post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，预训练缩放定律仍成立，但低垂果实已摘完；收益来自后训练和推理时扩展。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is dead; designers must ship fast and help engineers execute, not just hand off mocks.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已死；设计师必须快速交付并帮助工程师执行，而非仅仅移交原型。

jennywen.en: Design vision horizon shrinks from 2-5 years to 3-6 months; speed and iteration replace long-term planning.
jennywen.zh: 设计愿景的时间跨度从 2-5 年缩短至 3-6 个月；速度和迭代取代长期规划。

jennywen.en: Designers must be block-shaped generalists or cracked new grads; taste alone insufficient, judgment and vision key.
jennywen.zh: 设计师必须是块状通才或“破解的新毕业生”；仅靠品味不够，判断力和愿景是关键。

jennywen.en: Designers control AI adoption; wait 6 months before adopting new tools, put work and users at center.
jennywen.zh: 设计师掌控 AI 采用节奏；采用新工具前等待 6 个月，以工作和用户为中心。

jennywen.en: Speed is not an improvement; 'everyone is using it' is not a design argument; unique value is sitting with ambiguity.
jennywen.zh: 速度不是改进；‘人人都在用’不是设计论据；独特价值在于与模糊性共处。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、工艺和观点仍然至关重要；AI 输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas is superior to prompting for design adjustments; design becomes the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 在画布上直接操作优于通过提示词调整设计；设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Leaders should build things themselves to inspire teams; AI integration is at its very start.
dylanfield.zh: 领导者应亲自构建以激励团队；AI 整合才刚刚开始。

dylanfield.en: AI won't replace jobs; human taste and craft remain critical; role merging is more about responsibilities.
dylanfield.zh: AI 不会取代工作；人类品味和工艺仍然关键；角色融合更多是职责的融合。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展（2025）。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: AI 对齐紧迫；迭代部署有助于在真实世界中学习和缓解风险（2025）。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is core, achieved via scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现；思维链监控有助于对齐（2026）。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment focuses on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐聚焦于超越训练分布的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天（2026）。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中（2026）。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning surpasses hand-coded stacks; world models enable generalization and emergent safe behaviors.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，端到端深度学习超越手工编码栈；世界模型实现泛化和涌现的安全行为。

kendall.en: End-to-end neural nets are interpretable with modern tools; hybrid rule-based and learned systems get worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，端到端神经网络借助现代工具可解释；混合规则与学习系统反而两败俱伤。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar; AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside car.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，纯视觉可达人类水平，但超人类安全需雷达和激光雷达；AV 3.0 可能将智能移至车外。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem; scaling generalizable driver needs massive data, compute, and world models.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，自动驾驶本质是 AI 问题；扩展通用驾驶需要海量数据、算力和世界模型。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities possible; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis; infrastructure over algorithms key.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，零样本泛化覆盖 500+城市；消费车辆将超越 Robotaxi；基础设施重于算法。

karpathy.en: Scaling language models with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning; vision alone suffices for driving.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他主张通过下一个词预测扩展语言模型可涌现上下文学习等能力；并认为纯视觉足以支撑自动驾驶。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must preserve entropy; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right; humanoid robots benefit from car transfer.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他强调合成数据重要但需保持熵以避免模型崩溃；认可特斯拉端到端路线，并认为人形机器人可受益于汽车领域的迁移学习。

karpathy.en: LLMs are like operating systems; we're entering the decade of agents, not the year; vibe coding democratizes programming.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他将 LLM 比作操作系统，指出我们处于智能体十年而非元年；同时认为 vibe coding 降低了编程门槛。

karpathy.en: Pre-training is crappy evolution; RL needs better credit assignment; synthetic data causes model collapse; cognitive core may be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他批评预训练如粗糙进化，强化学习需改进信用分配，合成数据导致模型崩溃，并推测认知核心可能极小。

karpathy.en: Since December, I delegate all coding to agents; bottleneck is directing skill; agent-first tools and open-source health are vital.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他表示自去年 12 月起不再手写代码，全部交给智能体，瓶颈在于指挥能力；并强调智能体优先的工具和开源生态健康。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, needing new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 至少还需十年以上；仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress requires deep human evaluations with taste.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 等基准具有误导性且易被钻空子；真正的进步需要依靠有品味的深度人工评估。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next post-training stage, simulating real-world tasks for models.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务来训练模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate; human judgment is critical, and safety must prioritize over accuracy.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 可能产生幻觉，人类判断至关重要，安全必须优先于准确性。

edwinchen.en: Quality data creation requires taste and sophistication; different labs' objective functions shape diverse AI.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据创建需要品味和成熟度；不同实验室的目标函数塑造了多样化的 AI。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿提出 Scaling 本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的方法；反向传播并未解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: We should not control AI; let it develop permissionlessly. Safety via control is dangerous.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他主张不应控制 AI，而应让其无许可发展；通过控制来确保安全反而危险。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他强调强化学习是智能核心，下一个词预测缺乏实质目标。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning from runtime experience, no domain knowledge.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI 需要从运行时经验学习的通用架构，摒弃领域知识。

sutton.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; RL from human feedback isn't true learning.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他认为学习“利于学习的表征”是首要开放问题，基于人类反馈的强化学习并非真正的经验学习。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn from real users.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；要像软件一样迭代，每日发布，从真实用户中学习。

turley.en: Chat is not the end; future interface will be richer, like Windows after MS-DOS.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点；未来界面会更丰富，如同 MS-DOS 之后的 Windows。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous for frontier models, fast for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离；对前沿模型严格，对产品快速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product, model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自减少摩擦、产品与模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动且功能丰富的产品，超越聊天机器人。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，我认为 AI 在科学中应聚焦根节点问题而非窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 至 2026 年间，我强调 LLM 的幻觉若配合真值检测，可转化为创造性发现的工具。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is key to pushing beyond human knowledge, as AlphaGo showed.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，我指出后训练结合强化学习是超越人类知识的关键，AlphaGo 即是例证。

kohli.en: AI can produce correct but uninterpretable proofs, challenging human understanding; interpretability is not essential.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，我认为 AI 能产出正确但不可解释的证明，挑战人类理解，可解释性并非必需。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code and games are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 始终，我坚持可验证领域（如代码、游戏）对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities, like microscopes; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，认为 AI 应像显微镜一样增强人类能力，从视频学习和通用智能体是通往 AGI 的有希望路径。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogs legacy issues in AI; language models can revolutionize local education; AI safety remains an open problem.
nando.zh: 2026 年，强调非洲在 AI 上跨越式发展，语言模型可革新本地教育，AI 安全仍是未解难题。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion are essential for beneficial AI; human skills like communication matter as much as coding.
nando.zh: 始终认为多样性和包容性对有益 AI 至关重要，沟通等人文技能与编程同等重要。

nando.en: From focusing on technical paths (video learning, generalist agents) to emphasizing societal adoption and safety in Africa.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年关注技术路径（视频学习、通用智能体）转向 2026 年强调社会应用与安全，尤其在非洲。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence and solving onboarding.
sholto.zh: 2024 年：长上下文被低估；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能提升智能并解决上手问题。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning on verifiable rewards is a key breakthrough; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI by 2027-28.
sholto.zh: 2025 年：基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破；预训练加强化学习或足以在 2027-28 年实现 AGI。

sholto.en: Agent reliability over time horizon is the real bottleneck; coding leads progress, and inference compute will bottleneck by 2028.
sholto.zh: 2025 年：智能体在时间跨度上的可靠性才是瓶颈；编程引领进展，推理算力将在 2028 年成为瓶颈。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence (30h) expands capabilities; Transformers suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：强化学习成为新的扩展轴；更长的智能体连贯性（30 小时）扩展能力；Transformer 足以实现 AGI。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more; future work is managing agent teams; compute is the new oil.
sholto.zh: 2026 年：能力过剩意味着工具和编排更重要；未来工作是管理智能体团队；算力是新石油。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck; AI as creative partner; code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；将 AI 视为创意伙伴；代码为最终真相。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution with AI are most valuable; portfolios show craft, not process.
nadchishtie.zh: 掌握端到端执行并善用 AI 的通才最受青睐；作品集展示工艺而非流程。

nadchishtie.en: Small cross-functional teams outperform large squads; AI merges design and engineering roles.
nadchishtie.zh: 小型跨职能团队优于大团队；AI 融合设计与工程角色。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; ignoring it is like ignoring early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为常态；忽视它如同早期忽视互联网。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can match larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的数据和算法，较小的模型也能媲美较大的模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，我逐渐强调数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越它。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning requires careful engineering; RLVR can decrease pass@k even as best-of-n improves.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我认为强化学习需要精细工程；RLVR 可能降低 pass@k，即使 best-of-n 有所提升。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; debiasing the internet is impossible.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我主张多元对齐以尊重人类价值观多样性；对互联网去偏是不可能的。

yejin.en: Small models can be powerful with diverse synthetic data; RL during pre-training improves reasoning.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我认为通过多样化合成数据，小模型也能强大；预训练阶段的强化学习可提升推理能力。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会编程以建立同理心并加速交付；优先追求速度和熟悉感，而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand is a strategic weapon for recruiting and differentiation; invest early to attract talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 年到 2026 年，始终强调品牌是招聘和差异化的战略武器，应尽早投入以吸引人才。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; give designers autonomy and adapt process to problem.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多元类型而非同质化人才，赋予设计师自主权，并让流程适应问题而非套用模板。

henrymodisett.en: In fast-growing startups, gut decisions often beat data-driven ones; velocity trumps perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，认为在快速成长的初创公司，直觉决策常优于数据驱动，速度胜过完美。

brettaylor.en: AI agents will shift software to outcome-based pricing, making value measurable and enabling value-based pricing.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月，认为 AI 智能体将推动软件转向基于结果的定价，使价值可衡量，从而实现基于价值的定价。

brettaylor.en: Software engineering agents will transform developers from authors to operators of code-generating machines, requiring new languages prioritizing verifiability.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月至 9 月，持续强调软件工程智能体将开发者从作者转变为代码生成机器的操作者，需要优先考虑可验证性的新语言。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience will become as important as websites or mobile apps, and will be compared to other agents, not humans.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，提出客户体验 AI 智能体将变得与网站或移动应用同等重要，且十年内将被与其他智能体比较，而非与人类比较。

brettaylor.en: Most enterprise software incumbents will fail to transition to AI-native business models, facing business model challenges not just technology hurdles.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，认为大多数企业软件现有企业将无法转型为 AI 原生商业模式，面临商业模式挑战而非仅仅是技术障碍。

brettaylor.en: Generalists who leverage AI will outperform narrow specialists in creating breakthroughs, as AI agents mediate brand interactions and upend SEO.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，提出利用 AI 的通才将在创造突破方面胜过狭窄专家，同时 AI 智能体将中介品牌互动并颠覆 SEO。

scottwu.en: AI will increase demand for programmers, not reduce it, due to Jevons paradox.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 将因杰文斯悖论增加而非减少程序员需求。

scottwu.en: Engineers shift from writing code to architecting and defining problems.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，他提出工程师角色从写代码转向架构和定义问题。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation will outpace model capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 是渐进过程，产品创新将领先于模型能力。

scottwu.en: Enterprise AI agents need trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他认为企业 AI 智能体需要信任和权限，而非完全自主。

scottwu.en: Software engineering demand rises with AI; role evolves but persists.
scottwu.zh: 始终，他坚持软件工程需求随 AI 增长，角色演变但持续存在。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute may surpass pre-training as next driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，缩放定律预测进展，测试时算力可能超越预训练成为下一驱动力。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary coding method; examples and direct manipulation better.
truell.zh: 2024 年，自然语言不会成为主要编程方式，示例和直接操作更优。

truell.en: Agents promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration central.
truell.zh: 2024 年，智能体有前景但尚不实用，迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to intent specification; taste and logic design valued.
truell.zh: 2025 年，编程从代码转向意图描述，品味和逻辑设计更受重视。

truell.en: Custom models essential for product quality; every magic moment involves custom model.
truell.zh: 2025 年，定制模型对产品质量至关重要，每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; empirical research and skill-building matter more than capability work.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究尚待开发，实证研究和技能积累比能力研究更重要。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability to align superintelligence.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他强调 RLHF 无法扩展，需可扩展监督和可解释性来对齐超级智能。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient; external oversight necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，后训练不足以解决对齐，需外部监管。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction are an AI-complete problem; scaling with compute and data makes them smarter, but inner workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为基于下一个词预测训练的 LLM 是 AI 完备问题，规模扩张（Scaling）能提升智能，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; future models need trillion-token context windows and modular sparse architectures.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他强调推理时算力扩展是近期重大机遇，未来模型需支持万亿级上下文窗口，并采用模块化稀疏架构。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passive data; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察数据；模块化持续学习或取代整体重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial for AGI.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他认为测试时算力扩展推动进步，但单独无法实现 AGI；智能体能力和强化学习对 AGI 至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; its economic impact will be far beyond trillion-dollar products; coding is underhyped as it enables AI self-acceleration.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他称 AGI 被低估，经济影响远超万亿美元产品；编码应用也被低估，因它加速 AI 自我进化。
